comment: Independent apply.c witness for use_trap()'s mounted bungle: the debug Samurai, unskilled in riding, creates a tame saddled pony, forces the #ride, wishes a beartrap and applies it, and answers y to "Continue your attempt to set the bear trap?". The rnl(10) chance fails, so use_trap() drops the trap through do.c dropx(), whose dropz() tail calls newsym() and encumber_msg(). The pony's direction was read from the C screen for seed 9930006, the first of eleven seeds whose chance fails.
